Saved Views is available today, included in all paid plans at no extra cost. This feature lets you save the exact filters, sorting, and grouping you use most, then jump back to that setup instantly instead of rebuilding it every time you open a project. It's a simple way to keep your favorite layouts close at hand, whether you're tracking a sprint, reviewing overdue tasks, or organizing a backlog.

Each user can save up to 50 views, so you have plenty of room to set up separate views for different projects, clients, or workflows. Views can also be shared with your team, meaning a layout you build once can keep everyone aligned, whether that's a status board, a client-facing summary, or a weekly planning view.

No setup is required and there's nothing extra to enable. Just start creating views today, and share the ones your team will use most across every project you manage.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
